data:
{"operationName":"SESSION_STATUS_QUERY","variables":{},"query":"query SESSION_STATUS_QUERY {
  sessionStatus {
    adminUserId
    cart {
      itemCount
      orderNumber
      __typename
    }
    user {
      id
      firebaseUid
      giftCardBalance
      guestId
      fullName
      canSeeNsfwContent
      displayName
      vanityName
      email
      isOrganization
      isEmailVerified
      isPhoneVerified
      isIdentityVerified
      isOnCommissionsProgram
      availableWalletBalance {
        amount
        currency
        __typename
      }
      hasAcceptedCommissionsAgreement
      hasAcceptedStoresAgreement
      phone
      avatarUrl
      createdAt
      isAdmin
      clientRegion
      teams {
        active
        artworkIds
        isApprover
        becomeId
        becomeName
        becomePath
        becomeAvatar
        teamId
        canSavePaymentMethod
        creditLimit
        creditAvailable
        domainName
        vanityName
        __typename
      }
      websiteUrl
      storeCredit
      __typename
    }
    refId
    __typename
  }
}"}

  zipCode

  __typename

query SAVED_ADDRESSES_QUERY($excludeShippingAddresses: Boolean = false, $excludeBillingAddresses: Boolean = false) {
  shippingAddresses @skip(if: $excludeShippingAddresses) {
    ...AddressFields
    __typename
  }
  billingAddresses @skip(if: $excludeBillingAddresses) {
    ...AddressFields
    __typename

{"operationName":"SESSION_STATUS_QUERY","variables":{},"query":"query SESSION_STATUS_QUERY {
  sessionStatus {
    adminUserId
    cart {
      itemCount
      orderNumber
      __typename
    }
    user {
      id
      firebaseUid
      giftCardBalance
      guestId
      fullName
      canSeeNsfwContent
      displayName
      vanityName
      email
      isOrganization
      isEmailVerified
      isPhoneVerified
      isIdentityVerified
      isOnCommissionsProgram
      availableWalletBalance {
        amount
        currency
        __typename
      }
      hasAcceptedCommissionsAgreement
      hasAcceptedStoresAgreement
      phone
      avatarUrl
      createdAt
      isAdmin
      clientRegion
      teams {
        active
        artworkIds
        isApprover
        becomeId
        becomeName
        becomePath
        becomeAvatar
        teamId
        canSavePaymentMethod
        creditLimit
        creditAvailable
        domainName
        vanityName
        __typename
      }
      websiteUrl
      storeCredit
      __typename
    }
    refId
    __typename
  }
}"}

{"operationName":"SAVED_ADDRESSES_QUERY","variables":{"excludeShippingAddresses":false,"excludeBillingAddresses":false},"query":"fragment AddressFields on Address {
  address1: addressLine1
  address2: addressLine2
  city: cityName
  company: companyName
  countryIso
  country: countryName
  firstName
  fiscalCode
  freight {
    isResidentialAddress
    isLiftgateRequired
    __typename
  }
  id
  lastName
  name
  pecAddress
  phone
  receiverCode
  stateName
  stateAbbr: stateAbbreviation
  vatNumber
  zipCode
  isDefault
  isValid
  __typename
}

query SAVED_ADDRESSES_QUERY($excludeShippingAddresses: Boolean = false, $excludeBillingAddresses: Boolean = false) {
  shippingAddresses @skip(if: $excludeShippingAddresses) {
    ...AddressFields
    __typename
  }
  billingAddresses @skip(if: $excludeBillingAddresses) {
    ...AddressFields
    __typename
  }
}"}

{"operationName":"SAVED_ADDRESSES_QUERY","variables":{"excludeShippingAddresses":false,"excludeBillingAddresses":false},"query":"fragment AddressFields on Address {
  address1: addressLine1
  address2: addressLine2
  city: cityName
  company: companyName
  countryIso
  country: countryName
  firstName
  fiscalCode
  freight {
    isResidentialAddress
    isLiftgateRequired
    __typename
  }
  id
  lastName
  name
  pecAddress
  phone
  receiverCode
  stateName
  stateAbbr: stateAbbreviation
  vatNumber
  zipCode
  isDefault
  isValid
  __typename
}

query SAVED_ADDRESSES_QUERY($excludeShippingAddresses: Boolean = false, $excludeBillingAddresses: Boolean = false) {
  shippingAddresses @skip(if: $excludeShippingAddresses) {
    ...AddressFields
    __typename
  }
  billingAddresses @skip(if: $excludeBillingAddresses) {
    ...AddressFields
    __typename
  }
}"}

{"operationName":"SESSION_STATUS_QUERY","variables":{},"query":"query SESSION_STATUS_QUERY {
  sessionStatus {
    adminUserId
    cart {
      itemCount
      orderNumber
      __typename
    }
    user {
      id
      firebaseUid
      giftCardBalance
      guestId
      fullName
      canSeeNsfwContent
      displayName
      vanityName
      email
      isOrganization
      isEmailVerified
      isPhoneVerified
      isIdentityVerified
      isOnCommissionsProgram
      availableWalletBalance {
        amount
        currency
        __typename
      }
      hasAcceptedCommissionsAgreement
      hasAcceptedStoresAgreement
      phone
      avatarUrl
      createdAt
      isAdmin
      clientRegion
      teams {
        active
        artworkIds
        isApprover
        becomeId
        becomeName
        becomePath
        becomeAvatar
        teamId
        canSavePaymentMethod
        creditLimit
        creditAvailable
        domainName
        vanityName
        __typename
      }
      websiteUrl
      storeCredit
      __typename
    }
    refId
    __typename
  }
}"}
